idea-plugin.name: IconFontViewer
idea-plugin.description:
IconFont Viewer for Android Studio

Preview iconfont glyphs directly in the editor gutter when referencing string resources that map to icon font characters.

Features

  • Gutter Preview — See icon glyphs next to R.string.xxx references in Kotlin/Java, @string/xxx in XML layouts, and <string> definitions in strings.xml
  • Click to Replace — Click a gutter icon to browse all available icons from the matched font and replace the current reference
  • Smart TTF Detection — Automatically scans project sources and AAR dependencies for icon font TTF files at startup
  • Font Management Panel — Enable/disable fonts, add custom TTF files, rescan project via Tools → IconFontViewer
  • Unicode Support — Handles , , \uE88A, and raw Unicode characters

Supported Formats

  • TrueType (.ttf) font files only
  • Supports Android Studio 2024.1 (Koala) and newer
